subject: SIG: incident response roles, timelines, and evidence checklist
messages:
From: Clearwater Bank SecOps <secops@clearwaterbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@procurecorp.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: incident response / breach notification clarifications

Jordan —

Thanks for the SIG intake so far. A couple of clarifying questions from our side to finalize the questionnaire and to plan our procurement/legal review:

1) Notification windows: we need confirmation of your standard windows for customer notification in the event of a confirmed data breach impacting customer data (e.g., detection -> notification decision -> customer notification). Do you have an internal SLA (hours/days) you adhere to?

2) Point(s) of contact and roles: who is the primary POC we should reach out to for incident triage, legal escalation, and customer communications? We need names, roles, and phone/email for the SIG.

3) Evidence artifacts: list of the artifact types you can provide on request (audit logs, ingestion timelines, access logs, packet captures, retention policy docs). Any format/transfer preferences?

4) On-call and escalation: do you have a 24/7 on-call SRE or security rotation that will respond to customer escalations? If so, please provide the escalation matrix.

5) Regulatory timing: we operate in multiple regions and may need 72-hour notice commitments where applicable. Can you confirm whether Redwood’s process supports that cadence or if there are conditions/exceptions?

We attached our SIG request form to help map the answers. If preferred, we can set a short call next week (30 min) to walk through.

Appreciate a response by EOD Monday (8/23) so our team can keep the review moving.

Thanks,
Claire Martin
Senior Security Analyst — Clearwater Bank
secops@clearwaterbank.com
Attachment: Clearwater_SIG_Request_Form.xlsx
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Martin <secops@clearwaterbank.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: incident response / breach notification clarifications

Claire —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and I've attached a draft SIG response that maps our artifacts to your request. I'm CC'ing our Security and Legal leads so we can surface any binding legal constraints.

1) Notification windows (summary):
- Detection & initial triage: target 2 hours from alerted anomalous activity (may vary by severity).
- Incident classification & containment actions: initial decision within 24 hours for most incidents.
- Customer notification for confirmed regulator-impacting breaches: target 72 hours from classification when feasible; exceptions apply if investigation scope requires additional time (we commit to interim updates within the 72-hour window).
- Full incident report: typically delivered within 30 days, with rolling updates.

2) POCs/roles (primary SIG entries):
- Primary SecOps POC: Mina Haddad — Security Lead — mina_haddad@redwood.ai — +1-650-555-0142
- Legal escalation: Evelyn Hart — Senior Counsel — evelyn_hart@redwood.ai — +1-415-555-0198
- Product/ops contact (technical context): Jordan Blake — Product Security — jordan_blake@redwood.ai — +1-415-555-0127

3) Evidence artifacts we can provide:
- Time-stamped audit logs (auth/access) — CSV/ndjson
- Processed request traces (sampling) — JSON/CSV
- Worker-level compute logs (redwood runtime) — sanitized extracts
- KV cache hit/miss timelines (if relevant to exfil timelines)
- Retention policy docs and SOC 2 report excerpts where permitted
- Where necessary, we can provide forensic extracts under an executed NDA/secure transfer.

4) On-call & escalation: we maintain a 24/7 on-call rotation across SecOps and SRE. Initial on-call triage is managed by SecOps; more severe incidents escalate to SRE lead and Legal as required. Mina will share the escalation matrix and a redacted roster shortly.

5) Regulatory timing: we support the 72-hour notification cadence and will work to meet it for incidents meeting your criteria; exceptions occur when ongoing forensic work materially affects the ability to notify and/or when notification would compromise containment. We provide interim communications during the window.

Action items:
- Mina: will attach the roster and the evidence-index template.
- Evelyn: will confirm any legal constraints on sharing SOC 2 attachments and whether a narrow BAA/DSA addendum is necessary.

If you want a short call to walk the draft, I'm available Mon/Tue afternoons PT.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Product Security — Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | +1-415-555-0127
Attachment: SIG_response_draft.docx
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Martin <secops@clearwaterbank.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 18:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: incident response / breach notification clarifications

Claire, Jordan —

Adding operational detail as promised and attaching two artifacts: a redacted on-call roster and a lightweight evidence-index template we use when customers request packages.

Escalation matrix (brief):
- T+0–2h: Alert ingested; initial triage by on-call SecOps (ack + initial severity)
- T+2–24h: Full triage and containment playbook run; if containment confirmed, SecOps notifies Product Security + SRE on-call
- T+24–72h: Legal review for customer/regulatory notification; if notification required, Customer Communications coordinates messaging with Legal and SecOps
- Post 72h: Root cause analysis and remediation plan; rolling updates shared as available

On-call contacts (redacted):
- SecOps on-call (primary): +1-650-555-0142 (rota inbox: secops-oncall@redwood.ai)
- SRE incident lead (escalation): +1-650-555-0155

Evidence transfer notes:
- We prefer SFTP with per-file encryption or a secure portal (we can accept your secure upload). For highly sensitive forensic artifacts, we will request an NDA or a data processing addendum to limit scope.
- We provide an evidence index (CSV/MD) that maps artifacts to timestamps and retention policies.

Attachments: IR_Roles_and_Roster.csv, evidence-index-template.md

Let me know if you want me to pre-populate the index for the example events in your SIG request.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Security Lead — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1-650-555-0142
From: Claire Martin <secops@clearwaterbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, procurement@procurecorp.com
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 16:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: incident response roles, timelines, and evidence checklist

Jordan / Mina / Evelyn —

Appreciate the rapid detail and the attachments — that's helpful. A few follow-ups before we close the SIG entry:

- For the 72-hour notification: please confirm whether interim notifications (e.g., T+24 status update) are provided in writing by default, or only upon customer request. We prefer automatic interim status at T+24 for incidents likely to involve regulated data.
- Evidence: can you provide a sample (redacted) auth/access log extract and the evidence-index pre-populated for a hypothetical event? That will speed our reviewers and procurement. If you can share over the secure portal (DocuSign link listed on our intake), that'll be ideal.
- Legal: Evelyn, can you advise whether a short DPA addendum or BAA is required to accept full forensic artifacts? If so we'll route the DocuSign.

If you can get the sample artifacts and confirmation on the T+24 interim update by Monday EOD, we can close the SIG line item and move the contract through procurement.

Thanks again — Claire
Claire Martin
Senior Security Analyst — Clearwater Bank
